items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: We played the Aragon before Welk ever saw the place.

ctx.x: And there was no problem, they didn't object to mixed personnel?

Oh, no. They had a bunch of swinging dancers there. I mean that's what they wanted to do. You know, it was great for a jazz band to play at. Whereas the Palladium, you had to play everything, you know. The Casa Manana I loved. And then of course Tommy had the Casino Gardens - - Dorsey. We played there. We played the Aragon before Welk ever saw the place. We used to play out at Horace Heidt's Trianon Ballroom, and we played a place downtown, the Avadon, but -- they didn't lose anything, except possibly the -- you…

But the time when you couldn't play it was when it was operated as a full time band place where the Palladium hired the bands. When you later played it didn't you say that you played for another promoter?
